request.description: Returns a Stripe payment URL for the card order in {{orderId}}. While a page is still open it returns 200 with the same URL and reused=true; the backend checks with Stripe first, so a page Stripe already closed is replaced with a fresh one. If the customer already paid - even if Stripe's confirmation has not arrived yet - it answers 409 OrderAlreadyPaid and never opens a second page. 409 OrderNotPayable for a Cash on Delivery or cancelled order, 404 OrderNotFound for another customer's order.

item.description:
Online card payment through Stripe hosted checkout (test mode, no real money).

Run the Checkout folder first and place a Card order (request 5) - it saves {{orderId}}.
Then run 1, open the printed URL in a browser, pay with the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242
(any future expiry, any CVC), and run 2.

After paying, Stripe sends the customer to /payments/return/success; pressing back on
Stripe's page goes to /payments/return/cancel (requests 5 and 6 show both pages). The app
should close its webview as soon as it sees /payments/return/ and call request 2.

Request 2 is the one the app must trust. It also repairs: if Stripe took the money but no
event reached the backend, it finds out, marks the order paid and clears the cart before
answering.
